name: 28083-longdecode-qwen3next80b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four GPUs of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=4 with expert parallelism on, PP=1, DP=1, multiprocess executor.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1024, bounded at 4096 requests / 1800 s safety, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 32 tokens, output exactly 1024, ignore_eos on. `request_format: plain` and `temperature: 0.0` -- the raw completions endpoint, no chat template.
purpose: A long-form story generator expanding short prompts into 1024-token passages for 1024 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. vLLM at commit 17676585599934fe3f6e1bff61185a313c5da2cd.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct

# Four-way tensor parallel is what holds ~163 GB of bf16 weights on 80 GB cards; expert
# parallelism gives each rank whole experts of each MoE layer instead of a slice of every expert.
tensor-parallel-size: 4
enable-expert-parallel: true

enable-prefix-caching: false
async-scheduling: true

# LOAD-BEARING, not defaults -- do not delete either as redundant. The engine is built through the
# async path, whose usage context is in neither per-context table of `_set_default_args`, so an
# unpinned run falls through to the library default of 128 sequences: an eighth of the concurrency
# this item declares, which would silently turn a 1024-stream closed loop into a 128-deep queue.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-chunked-prefill: true

max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# HAZARD: do not raise the cuda-graph capture ceiling. `--max_cudagraph_capture_size=2048` aborts
# this engine during KV-cache init on an H100 with `ValueError: Capture size larger than 992 is not
# supported for full cuda graph.` -- the FA3 AOT-scheduler guard. Left unset it resolves to 512.
#
# There is no attention-backend engine argument at this commit; VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND is left
# unset, and on SM 9.0 with a bf16 KV cache and head size 256 the engine selects FlashAttention.
